data.hook: Ben Johns' Perseus Pro IV power paddle, in a limited-edition sunset colourway.
why: Tech Flex foam adds power and widens the sweet spot
Honeycomb Propulsion core for dwell time and a soft, controlled feel
Hyper-Foam edge wall for an edge-to-edge sweet spot
Textured carbon face for spin and low dinks
Limited-edition Summer Daze design: gradient orange-to-teal edge
data.playStyle: All-court players who want pop on drives and put-aways with enough touch for the kitchen.
data.summary: The Summer Daze is a limited-edition colourway of the JOOLA Perseus Pro IV 16mm, the paddle Ben Johns helped build. It pairs the Pro IV's power-forgiveness tech with a vivid gradient design.
data.description:
The Perseus Pro IV keeps the classic Perseus shape but adds Tech Flex: foam outside the frame, under the edge guard, that enlarges the sweet spot and adds power. The Propulsion core and Hyper-Foam edge wall give a soft, stable feel with plenty of dwell time.

A 5.5" handle leaves room for two-handed backhands, and the textured carbon face helps you shape drives and keep dinks low. The Summer Daze finish is a limited run.

tech.name: Tech Flex
tech.text: Foam outside the frame, under the edge guard, for a larger sweet spot and more power.

tech.name: Propulsion Core
tech.text: Honeycomb core that adds dwell time and a soft feel.

tech.name: Hyper-Foam Edge Wall
tech.text: Widens the sweet spot and steadies weight and balance.

tech.name: Textured carbon face
tech.text: Durable texture for spin and precise placement.

tech.name: 5.5" handle
tech.text: Room for two-handed backhands and fast swing speed.

faq.q: Is the Summer Daze different from the regular Perseus Pro IV?
faq.a: Performance is the same Perseus Pro IV 16mm. The difference is the limited-edition design.
Yes, USA Pickleball and UPA-A approved.
It leans to power, but the 16 mm core and foam edge keep it controllable at the kitchen.

data.clubTake: Brand new, unused. A pro-level paddle that also looks great. Ask to hit with it on court before you decide.
